risks.risk: The valve may be damaged or leaking.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the valve assembly and a video of a soap bubble test.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be empty or contain a different gas than intended.
risks.proof: A photo of the cylinder's weight or a video showing the valve being opened.

Close-up photo of the valve and a video of it being tested.
Photo of the cylinder's weight if it is a commercial unit.
